title.raw: 卷四十 本紀第四十: 順帝三 Volume 40 Annals 40: Shundi 3

sentences.zh: 順帝三

translations.literal: Shundi 3
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 3

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，禁濫予僧人名爵。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on guihai day, indiscriminate bestowal of ranks and titles upon Buddhist monks was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the guihai day of the first month of spring, indiscriminate bestowal of ranks and titles upon Buddhist monks was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，熒惑犯天江。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 濮州鄄城、範縣饑，賑鈔二千一百八十錠。

translations.literal: Yuncheng and Fan counties of Puzhou suffered famine; two thousand one hundred eighty ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yuncheng and Fan counties in Puzhou were starving. Two thousand one hundred eighty ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 冀寧路交城等縣饑，賑米七千石。

translations.literal: Jiaocheng and other counties of the Jining Route suffered famine; seven thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaocheng and other counties on the Jining Route were starving. Seven thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 桓州饑，賑鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: Huan Prefecture suffered famine; two thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Prefecture was starving. Two thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 雲需府饑，賑鈔五千錠。

translations.literal: Yunxu Prefecture suffered famine; five thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxu Prefecture was starving. Five thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 開平縣饑，賑米兩月。

translations.literal: Kaiping County suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for two months.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiping County was starving. Grain relief was provided for two months.

sentences.zh: 興和寶昌等處饑，賑鈔萬五千錠。

translations.literal: Baochang and other places in Xinghe suffered famine; fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Baochang and other districts in Xinghe were starving. Fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，信州雨土。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengyin day, Xin Prefecture experienced a rain of dust.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengyin day, Xin Prefecture experienced a rain of dust.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免廣海添辦鹽課萬五千引，止辦元額。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the additional salt tax of fifteen thousand yin levied for Guanghai was remitted; only the original quota was to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the additional salt levy of fifteen thousand yin imposed on Guanghai was remitted, and only the original quota was to be collected.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the moon transgressed the Spirit Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the moon transgressed the Spirit Terrace.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，八魯剌思千戶所民被災，遣太禧宗禋院斷事官塔海發米賑之。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinyou day, the people of the Baluras Thousand-Household Office suffered disaster; the adjudication officer Ta Hai of the Grand Council of Imperial Sacrifices was sent to distribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, the people of the Baluras Thousand-Household Office were stricken by disaster. The adjudication officer Ta Hai of the Grand Council of Imperial Sacrifices was dispatched to distribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，灤河住冬怯憐口民饑，每戶賑糧一石、鈔二十兩。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the qielian dependents wintering along the Luan River suffered famine; each household was given one shi of grain and twenty liang of paper money for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the qielian dependents wintering along the Luan River were starving. Each household received one shi of grain and twenty liang of paper money in relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，革興州興安縣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, Xing'an County of Xing Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day, Xing'an County in Xing Prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立伯顏南口過街塔二碑。

translations.literal: On guisi day, two steles were erected for Bayan's street-crossing pagoda at Nankou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, two steles were erected for Bayan's street-crossing pagoda at Nankou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加封孝女曹娥為慧感靈孝昭順純懿夫人。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the filial daughter Cao E was further ennobled as Lady of Sagacious Feeling, Spirit Filiality, Bright Compliance, and Pure Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the filial daughter Cao E was further ennobled as Lady of Sagacious Feeling, Spirit Filiality, Bright Compliance, and Pure Integrity.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯日星及房宿。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the moon transgressed the sun star and the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the moon transgressed the sun star and the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 己酉，申漢人、南人、高麗人不得執軍器、弓矢之禁。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the prohibition against Han people, southern Chinese, and Koreans bearing military weapons and bows was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the prohibition against Han people, southern Chinese, and Koreans bearing military weapons and bows was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月己未朔，晃火兒不剌、賽禿不剌、紐阿叠列孫、三卜剌等處六愛馬大風雪，民饑，發米賑之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the new moon of jiwei day, at the six ai ma districts of Qorqas Bulag, Setu Bulag, Niu'a Delisun, and Sanbuqa and elsewhere, great wind and snow struck; the people suffered famine, and grain was distributed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of the jiwei day, great wind and snow struck the six horse-pasture districts of Qorqas Bulag, Setu Bulag, Niu'a Delisun, Sanbuqa, and elsewhere. The people were starving, and grain was distributed for relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太白犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Venus transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Venus transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，加封瀏陽州道吾山龍神崇惠昭應靈顯廣濟侯。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the dragon god of Mount Daowu in Liuyang Prefecture was further ennobled as Marquis of Exalted Favor, Bright Response, Spirit Manifestation, and Broad Succor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the dragon god of Mount Daowu in Liuyang Prefecture was further ennobled as Marquis of Exalted Favor, Bright Response, Spirit Manifestation, and Broad Succor.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，月食。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renyin day, there was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renyin day, there was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，熒惑退入南斗。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Mars withdrew into the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Mars withdrew into the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，汀州路長汀縣大水，平地深可三丈餘，沒民廬八百家，壞民田二百頃，戶賑鈔半錠，死者一錠。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Changting County of Tingzhou Route suffered great flood; on level ground the water was more than three zhang deep, drowning eight hundred households' dwellings and ruining two hundred qing of farmland; each household was given half an ingot of paper money for relief, and each of the dead one ingot.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Changting County on the Tingzhou Route was struck by great flooding. On level ground the water stood more than three zhang deep, drowning the dwellings of eight hundred households and ruining two hundred qing of farmland. Each household received half an ingot of paper money in relief, and each of the dead one ingot.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，達達民饑，賑糧三月。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the Mongol people suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for three months.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the Mongol people were starving. Grain relief was provided for three months.

sentences.zh: 是月，沂、莒二州民饑，發糧賑糶之。

translations.literal: That month, the people of Yi and Ju prefectures suffered famine; grain was issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Yi and Ju prefectures were starving. Grain was issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉、壬戌，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou and renxu days, Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinyou and renxu days, Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲子，熒惑犯南斗，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper, and the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper, and the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 丙子，開上都、興和等處酒禁。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the prohibition on wine was lifted in Shangdu, Xinghe, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the prohibition on wine was lifted in Shangdu, Xinghe, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封皇姊月魯公主為昌國大長公主。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the emperor's elder sister Princess Yuelu was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Chang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the emperor's elder sister Princess Yuelu was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Chang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸王位下官毋入常選。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Officials under princely households shall not enter the regular selection."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Officials serving under princely households shall not enter the regular civil-service selection."

sentences.zh: 」甲申，常州宜興山水出，勢高二丈，壞民廬。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, at Yixing in Chang Prefecture mountains discharged water; the surge was two zhang high and destroyed people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, at Yixing in Chang Prefecture a mountain torrent burst forth. The surge stood two zhang high and destroyed people's dwellings.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白經天。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白復經天。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Venus again crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dinghai day, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 祭社稷。

translations.literal: Sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白復經天。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Venus again crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宗王脫歡脫木爾各愛馬人民饑，以鈔三萬四千九百錠賑之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the people of each ai ma district under Prince Toqto'a Temur suffered famine; thirty-four thousand nine hundred ingots of paper money were issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the people of each horse-pasture district under Prince Toqto'a Temur were starving. Thirty-four thousand nine hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 宗王脫憐渾禿各愛馬人民饑，以鈔萬一千三百五十七錠賑之。

translations.literal: The people of each ai ma district under Prince Tolian Quntu suffered famine; eleven thousand three hundred fifty-seven ingots of paper money were issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: The people of each horse-pasture district under Prince Tolian Quntu were starving. Eleven thousand three hundred fifty-seven ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 太白經天。

translations.literal: Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白復經天。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Venus again crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Venus transgressed the Chariot Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Venus transgressed the Chariot Pivot.

sentences.zh: 戊戌、己亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuxu and jihai days, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu and jihai days, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 壬寅至甲辰，太白復經天。

translations.literal: From renyin through jiachen days, Venus again crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: From the renyin through the jiachen days, Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，沈陽饑，民食木皮，賑糶米一千石。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dingsi day, Shenyang suffered famine; the people ate tree bark; one thousand shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingsi day, Shenyang was starving and the people ate tree bark. One thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 己未，太白復經天。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Venus again crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁倡優盛服，許男子裹青巾，婦女服紫衣，不許戴笠、乘馬。

translations.literal: On renchen day, actors and entertainers were forbidden extravagant dress; men were permitted to wrap blue headcloths and women to wear purple garments, but they were not permitted to wear hats or ride horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, actors and entertainers were forbidden extravagant dress. Men were permitted to wrap blue headcloths and women to wear purple garments, but they were not permitted to wear hats or ride horses.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔命伯顏為大丞相，加元德上輔功臣之號，賜七寶玉書龍虎金符。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, an edict appointed Bayan as Grand Chancellor, added to him the title of meritorious minister as supreme assistant of primal virtue, and bestowed upon him a seven-jewel jade book and dragon-tiger gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, an edict appointed Bayan grand chancellor, conferred upon him the title of meritorious minister as supreme assistant of primal virtue, and bestowed a seven-jewel jade book and dragon-tiger gold tally.

sentences.zh: 己亥，熒惑犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Mars transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Mars transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 是月，衡州饑，賑糶米五千石。

translations.literal: That month, Heng Prefecture suffered famine; five thousand shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Heng Prefecture was starving. Five thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 遼陽饑，賑米五百石。

translations.literal: Liaoyang suffered famine; five hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Liaoyang was starving. Five hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 文登、牟平二縣饑，賑糶米一萬石。

translations.literal: Wendeng and Mouping counties suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Wendeng and Mouping counties were starving. Ten thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，熒惑犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingsi day, Mars transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingsi day, Mars transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 禁宰殺。

translations.literal: Slaughter was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Slaughter was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，開封杞縣人範孟反，偽傳帝旨，殺河南行省平章政事月祿帖木兒、左丞劫烈、廉訪使完者不花等，已而捕誅之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Fan Meng of Qi County in Kaifeng rebelled, forged an imperial order, and killed Yuelu Temur, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, the left vice director Jielie, the surveillance commissioner Qanbuqa, and others; afterward he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Fan Meng of Qi County in Kaifeng rebelled, forged an imperial order, and killed Yuelu Temur, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, the left vice director Jielie, the surveillance commissioner Qanbuqa, and others. He was afterward captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，瑞州路新昌州雨木冰，至明年二月始解。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Xinchang Prefecture on the Ruizhou Route experienced freezing rain on trees; it did not melt until the second month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Xinchang Prefecture on the Ruizhou Route was struck by freezing rain on the trees. The ice did not melt until the second month of the following year.

sentences.zh: 是月，八番順元等處饑，賑鈔二萬二十錠。

translations.literal: That month, Shunyuan and other places in the Eight Banners region suffered famine; twenty thousand twenty ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shunyuan and other districts in the Eight Banners region were starving. Twenty thousand twenty ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，復立都水庸田使司於平江。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinmao day, the Directorate of Water Control and Government Granaries was re-established at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinmao day, the Directorate of Water Control and Government Granaries was re-established at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 先是嘗置而罷，至是復立。

translations.literal: It had previously been established and then abolished; now it was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: It had previously been established and then abolished; now it was re-established.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，熒惑犯外屏。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Mars transgressed the Outer Screen.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Mars transgressed the Outer Screen.

sentences.zh: 是歲，敕賜曲阜宣聖廟碑。

translations.literal: That year, an imperial command bestowed a stele for the Temple of the Sagely Exemplar at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: That year an imperial command bestowed a stele for the Temple of the Sagely Exemplar at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 工部廳梁上出芝草，一本七莖。

translations.literal: On a beam in the Ministry of Works hall, lingzhi fungus appeared; one plant had seven stalks.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi fungus appeared on a beam in the Ministry of Works hall; one plant bore seven stalks.

sentences.zh: 袁州饑，賑糶米五千石。

translations.literal: Yuan Prefecture suffered famine; five thousand shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Prefecture was starving. Five thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 膠、密、莒、濰等州饑，賑鈔二萬錠。

translations.literal: Jiao, Mi, Ju, Wei, and other prefectures suffered famine; twenty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao, Mi, Ju, Wei, and other prefectures were starving. Twenty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁卯，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the dingmao day of the first month of spring, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立司禋監，奉太祖、太宗、睿宗三朝御容於石佛寺。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was established to enshrine the imperial portraits of the Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong reigns at Shifo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was established to enshrine the imperial portraits of the Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong reigns at Shifo Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，追封闊兒吉思宣誠戡難翊運致美功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封晉寧王，謚忠襄。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Korguz was posthumously enfeoffed as meritorious minister who proclaimed sincerity, quelled hardship, and aided the realm to achieve beauty, Grand Preceptor, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with credentials equal to those of the Three Dukes, and Pillar of the State of the First Rank; posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Jinning; posthumous title Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Korguz was posthumously enfeoffed as meritorious minister who proclaimed sincerity, quelled hardship, and aided the realm to achieve beauty, as grand preceptor, as grand master of splendid happiness with credentials equal to those of the three dukes, and as pillar of the state of the first rank. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Jinning with the posthumous title Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 是月，察忽、察罕腦兒等處馬災，賑鈔六千八百五十八錠。

translations.literal: That month, at Chaqu, Qaghan Na'ur, and other places horses suffered disaster; six thousand eight hundred fifty-eight ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month horses at Chaqu, Qaghan Na'ur, and other districts suffered disaster. Six thousand eight hundred fifty-eight ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 邳州饑，賑米兩月。

translations.literal: Pi Prefecture suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for two months.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Prefecture was starving. Grain relief was provided for two months.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申朔，詔權止今年印鈔。

translations.literal: Second month, on the new moon of jiashen day, an edict temporarily halted printing paper money for this year.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of the jiashen day, an edict temporarily halted the printing of paper money for that year.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己亥，黜中書大丞相伯顏為河南行省左丞相，詔曰：「朕踐位以來，命伯顏為太師、秦王、中書大丞相，而伯顏不能安分，專權自恣，欺朕年幼，輕視太皇太后及朕弟燕帖古思，變亂祖宗成憲，虐害天下。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Grand Chancellor Bayan of the Secretariat was demoted to left chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat. The edict stated: "Since I ascended the throne, I appointed Bayan Grand Preceptor, Prince of Qin, and Grand Chancellor of the Secretariat, yet Bayan could not keep his place, monopolized power and acted willfully, deceived me in my youth, held the empress dowager and my younger brother Yantughus in contempt, altered the established statutes of the ancestors, and cruelly harmed the realm."
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Grand Chancellor Bayan of the Secretariat was demoted to left chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat. The edict stated: "Since I ascended the throne, I appointed Bayan grand preceptor, Prince of Qin, and grand chancellor of the Secretariat, yet Bayan could not keep his place. He monopolized power and acted willfully, deceived me in my youth, held the empress dowager and my younger brother Yantughus in contempt, altered the established statutes of the ancestors, and cruelly harmed the realm."

sentences.zh: 加以極刑，允合輿論。

translations.literal: To impose the extreme penalty upon him would accord with public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: To impose the extreme penalty upon him would accord with public opinion.

sentences.zh: 朕念先朝之故，尚存憫恤，今命伯顏出為河南行省左丞相。

translations.literal: Considering the ties of the former court, I still retain compassion; now I order Bayan to go forth as left chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Considering the ties of the former court, I still retain compassion. I now order Bayan to go forth as left chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 所有元領諸衛親軍並怯薛丹人等，詔書到時，即許散還。

translations.literal: All guards, personal troops, and qešig retainers originally under his command, when the edict arrives, are at once permitted to be dispersed and returned.
translations.idiomatic: All guards, personal troops, and qešig retainers originally under his command are, when the edict arrives, at once permitted to be dispersed and returned.

sentences.zh: 」以太保馬劄兒臺為太師、中書右丞相，太尉塔失海牙為太傅，知樞密院事塔馬赤為太保，御史大夫脫脫為知樞密院事，汪家奴為中書平章政事，嶺北行省平章政事也先帖木兒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Mažiltai was appointed Grand Preceptor and right chief minister of the Secretariat; Taš Haiya was appointed Grand Mentor; Tamači, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed Grand Guardian; the censor-in-chief Toqto was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wangjianu was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat; and Yesun Temur, chief minister of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Mažiltai was appointed grand preceptor and right chief minister of the Secretariat; Taš Haiya was appointed grand mentor; Tamači, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed grand guardian; the censor-in-chief Toqto was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wangjianu was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat; and Yesun Temur, chief minister of the Lingbei branch secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 增設京城米鋪，從便賑糶。

translations.literal: Additional grain shops were established in the capital for convenient relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: Additional grain shops were established in the capital for convenient relief sales.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔：「除知樞密院事脫脫之外，諸王侯不得懸帶弓箭、環刀輒入內府。

translations.literal: On renyin day, an edict stated: "Apart from Toqto, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, no prince or marquis may enter the inner palace wearing bows and arrows or ring-handled swords."
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict stated: "Apart from Toqto, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, no prince or marquis may enter the inner palace wearing bows and arrows or ring-handled swords."

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷各處船戶提舉、廣東采珠提舉二司。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the two offices of the Ship-Household Intendant in various places and the Guangdong Pearl-Fishing Intendant were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the ship-household intendancies in various places and the Guangdong pearl-fishing intendancy were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太陰犯羅堰。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the moon transgressed the Luo Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the moon transgressed the Luo Embankment.

sentences.zh: 立延徽寺，以奉寧宗祀事。

translations.literal: Yanhui Temple was established to conduct sacrifices for Emperor Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhui Temple was established to conduct sacrifices for Emperor Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 罷司禋監。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was abolished.

sentences.zh: 罷通州、河西務等處抽分按利房，大都東裏山查提領所。

translations.literal: The extraction and profit-assessment offices at Tongzhou, Hexiwu, and other places, and the intendant office of Shancha in the eastern suburbs of the capital, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The extraction and profit-assessment offices at Tongzhou, Hexiwu, and other places, and the intendant office of Shancha in the eastern suburbs of the capital, were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，熒惑犯月星。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Mars transgressed the moon star.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Mars transgressed the moon star.

sentences.zh: 己酉，彗星如房星大，色白，狀如粉絮，尾跡約長五寸余。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, a comet was as large as the Room star, white in color, shaped like powdered floss, with a tail trace about five cun long.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, a comet appeared as large as the Room star, white in color and shaped like powdered floss, with a tail trace about five cun long.

sentences.zh: 彗指西南，漸向西北行。

translations.literal: The comet pointed southwest and gradually moved toward the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The comet pointed southwest and gradually moved toward the northwest.

sentences.zh: 是月，福寧州大水，溺死人民。

translations.literal: That month, Funing Prefecture suffered great flood and people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That month Funing Prefecture was struck by great flooding and people drowned.

sentences.zh: 京畿五州十一縣水，每戶賑米兩月。

translations.literal: Five prefectures and eleven counties of the capital region suffered flood; each household was given grain for relief for two months.
translations.idiomatic: Five prefectures and eleven counties in the capital region were flooded. Each household received two months of grain relief.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，漳州義士陳君用襲殺反賊李誌甫，授君用同知漳州路總管府事。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiayin day, the righteous gentleman Chen Junyong of Zhang Prefecture attacked and killed the rebel Li Zhifu; Junyong was appointed vice administrator of the Zhangzhou Route headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiayin day, the righteous gentleman Chen Junyong of Zhang Prefecture attacked and killed the rebel Li Zhifu. Junyong was appointed vice administrator of the Zhangzhou Route headquarters.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，益都、般陽等處饑，賑之。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Yidu, Panyang, and other places suffered famine; relief was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Yidu, Panyang, and other districts were starving. Relief was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，赦漳、潮二州民為李誌甫、劉虎仔脅從之罪，褒贈軍將死事者。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the people of Zhang and Chao prefectures who had been coerced into following Li Zhifu and Liu Huzai were pardoned, and military officers who died in service were posthumously honored.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the people of Zhang and Chao prefectures who had been coerced into following Li Zhifu and Liu Huzai were pardoned, and military officers who died in service were posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大斡耳朵思風雪為災，馬多死，以鈔八萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, at the Great Ordo, wind and snow caused disaster and many horses died; eighty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, at the Great Ordo, wind and snow caused disaster and many horses died. Eighty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，四怯薛役戶饑，賑米一千石、鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the service households of the four qešig suffered famine; one thousand shi of grain and two thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the service households of the four qešig were starving. One thousand shi of grain and two thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 成宗潛邸四怯薛戶饑，賑米二百石、鈔二百錠。

translations.literal: The four qešig households of Chengzong's former residence suffered famine; two hundred shi of grain and two hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The four qešig households of Chengzong's former residence were starving. Two hundred shi of grain and two hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 以知樞密院事脫脫、御史大夫別兒怯不花、知樞密院事牙不花知經筵事，中書參議阿魯佛住兼經筵官。

translations.literal: Toqto, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the censor-in-chief Barqa Buqa; and Yabuqha, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium; Arufozhu, deliberator of the Secretariat, was concurrently made a Classics Colloquium officer.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the censor-in-chief Barqa Buqa; and Yabuqha, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium. Arufozhu, deliberator of the Secretariat, was concurrently made a Classics Colloquium officer.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Chariot Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Chariot Pivot.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔賜江南行臺御史中丞史惟良、御史中丞耿煥、山東廉訪使張友諒、中書參知政事許有壬上尊、束帛。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, an edict bestowed libation vessels and silks upon Shi Weiliang, vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate; Geng Huan, vice censor-in-chief; Zhang Youliang, surveillance commissioner of Shandong; and Xu Youren, associate administrator of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, an edict bestowed libation vessels and silks upon Shi Weiliang, vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate; Geng Huan, vice censor-in-chief; Zhang Youliang, surveillance commissioner of Shandong; and Xu Youren, associate administrator of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔徙伯顏於南恩州陽春縣安置。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, an edict ordered Bayan transferred and settled in Yangchun County, Nan'en Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, an edict ordered Bayan transferred and settled in Yangchun County, Nan'en Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以治書侍御史達識帖睦邇為奎章閣大學士，翰林直學士揭傒斯為奎章閣供奉學士。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Dash Temür, supervising secretary of the Secretariat, was appointed grand academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion; Jie Xisi, direct academician of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed offering academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Dash Temür, supervising secretary of the Secretariat, was appointed grand academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion; Jie Xisi, direct academician of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed offering academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白犯月星。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus transgressed the moon star.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus transgressed the moon star.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，彗星不見，自二月己酉至三月庚辰，凡見三十二日。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the comet was no longer seen; from the jiyou day of the second month through the gengchen day of the third month, it had been visible for thirty-two days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the comet was no longer seen. From the jiyou day of the second month through the gengchen day of the third month, it had been visible for thirty-two days in all.

sentences.zh: 是月，淮安路山陽縣饑，賑鈔二午五百錠，給糧兩月。

translations.literal: That month, Shanyang County on the Huai'an Route suffered famine; two thousand five hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief, and grain was provided for two months.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shanyang County on the Huai'an Route was starving. Two thousand five hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief, and grain was provided for two months.

sentences.zh: 順德路邢臺縣饑，賑鈔三千錠。

translations.literal: Xingtai County on the Shunde Route suffered famine; three thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Xingtai County on the Shunde Route was starving. Three thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jichou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jichou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔大天源延聖寺立明宗神御殿碑。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an edict ordered the Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple to erect a stele for the spirit hall of Emperor Mingzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered the Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple to erect a stele for the spirit hall of Emperor Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 以同知樞密院事鐵木兒塔識為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Temür Taši, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Temür Taši, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔封馬劄兒臺為忠王及加答剌罕之號，馬劄兒臺辭。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, an edict enfeoffed Mažiltai as Prince of Loyalty and added to him the title of Qaγan; Mažiltai declined.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict enfeoffed Mažiltai as Prince of Loyalty and added to him the title of Qaγan. Mažiltai declined.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，禁民間藏軍器。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guichou day, the private possession of military weapons by the people was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guichou day, private possession of military weapons by the people was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，監察御史普魯臺言：「右丞相馬劄兒臺辭答剌罕及王爵名號，宜示天下，以勸廉讓。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the investigating censor Pulutai stated: "The right chief minister Mažiltai declined the titles of Qaγan and prince; this should be made known throughout the realm to encourage integrity and modesty."
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the investigating censor Pulutai stated: "The right chief minister Mažiltai declined the titles of Qaγan and prince. This should be made known throughout the realm to encourage integrity and modesty."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was accepted.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔以黨兀巴太子擒賊阿答理胡，歿於王事，追封涼王，謚忠烈。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, an edict stated that Prince Dangquba captured the bandit Adaliq, died in the king's service, and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liang with the posthumous title Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, an edict stated that Prince Dangquba captured the bandit Adaliq and died in the king's service. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liang with the posthumous title Zhonglie.

sentences.zh: 漳州龍巖尉黃佐才獲李誌甫余黨鄭子箕，佐才因與賊戰，妻子四十餘口皆遇害，以佐才為龍巖縣尹。

translations.literal: Huang Zuocai, commandant of Longyan in Zhang Prefecture, captured Zheng Ziji, a remnant follower of Li Zhifu; because Zuocai fought the bandits, more than forty members of his household, wife and children included, were all killed; Zuocai was appointed magistrate of Longyan County.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zuocai, commandant of Longyan in Zhang Prefecture, captured Zheng Ziji, a remnant follower of Li Zhifu. Because Zuocai fought the bandits, more than forty members of his household, wife and children included, were all killed. Zuocai was appointed magistrate of Longyan County.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降鈔萬錠，給守衛宮闕內外門禁唐兀，左、右阿速，貴赤，阿兒渾，欽察等衛軍。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued to the Tangut, left and right Asud, Qorčin, Arqun, Qangli, and other guards defending the inner and outer gates of the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued to the Tangut, left and right Asud, Qorčin, Arqun, Qangli, and other guards defending the inner and outer gates of the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 置月祭各影堂香於大明殿，遇行禮時，令省臣就殿迎香祭之。

translations.literal: Incense for the monthly sacrifices at each spirit hall was placed in the Hall of Great Brightness; when rites were performed, secretariat officials were ordered to go to the hall to receive the incense and offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Incense for the monthly sacrifices at each spirit hall was placed in the Hall of Great Brightness. When rites were performed, secretariat officials were ordered to go to the hall to receive the incense and offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 以宦者伯不花為長寧寺卿。

translations.literal: The eunuch Baquhua was appointed director of Changning Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Baquhua was appointed director of Changning Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，濟南饑，賑鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: That month, Jinan suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jinan was starving. Ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，詔撤文宗廟主，徙太皇太后不答失裏東安州安置，放太子燕帖古思於高麗，其略曰：

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day, an edict ordered the removal of Wenzong's spirit tablet, the transfer of Empress Dowager Budashiri for settlement in Dong'an Prefecture, and the release of the crown prince Yantughus to Goryeo. The gist stated:
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingshen day, an edict ordered the removal of Wenzong's spirit tablet, the transfer of Empress Dowager Budashiri for settlement in Dong'an Prefecture, and the release of the crown prince Yantughus to Goryeo. The gist stated:

sentences.zh: 昔我皇祖武宗皇帝升遐之後，祖母太皇太后惑於憸慝，俾皇考明宗皇帝出封雲南。

translations.literal: Formerly, after my imperial ancestor Emperor Wuzong passed away, the empress dowager my grandmother was misled by the wicked and caused my imperial father Emperor Mingzong to be enfeoffed and sent out to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, after my imperial ancestor Emperor Wuzong passed away, my grandmother the empress dowager was misled by the wicked and caused my imperial father Emperor Mingzong to be enfeoffed and sent out to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 英宗遇害，正統浸偏，我皇考以武宗之嫡，逃居朔漠，宗王大臣同心翊戴，肇啟大事，於時以地近，先迎文宗，暫總機務。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong was murdered, the legitimate succession was gradually skewed; my imperial father, as the legitimate son of Wuzong, fled to dwell in the northern deserts; the princes and great ministers united in heart to support him and began the great enterprise; at that time, because the distance was near, Wenzong was first welcomed to provisionally oversee state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong was murdered, the legitimate succession was gradually skewed. My imperial father, as the legitimate son of Wuzong, fled to dwell in the northern deserts. The princes and great ministers united in heart to support him and began the great enterprise. At that time, because the distance was near, Wenzong was first welcomed to provisionally oversee state affairs.

sentences.zh: 繼知天理人倫之攸當，假讓位之名，以寶璽來上，皇考推誠不疑，即授以皇太子寶。

translations.literal: Subsequently, knowing what was proper in heavenly principle and human relations, he borrowed the name of yielding the throne and brought up the imperial seal; my imperial father trusted him in good faith and at once bestowed upon him the crown prince's seal.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, knowing what was proper in heavenly principle and human relations, he borrowed the name of yielding the throne and brought up the imperial seal. My imperial father trusted him in good faith and at once bestowed upon him the crown prince's seal.

sentences.zh: 文宗稔惡不悛，當躬迓之際，乃與其臣月魯不花、也裏牙、明裏董阿等謀為不軌，使我皇考飲恨上賓。

translations.literal: Wenzong, long steeped in evil and unrepentant, at the very moment of going forth to welcome him in person, plotted treason with his ministers Yelu Buqa, Yiliya, Mingli Dong'a, and others, causing my imperial father to die with resentment unavenged.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong, long steeped in evil and unrepentant, at the very moment of going forth to welcome him in person plotted treason with his ministers Yelu Buqa, Yiliya, Mingli Dong'a, and others, causing my imperial father to die with resentment unavenged.

sentences.zh: 歸而再禦宸極，思欲自解於天下，乃謂夫何數日之間，宮車弗駕。

translations.literal: Returning to mount the throne again, wishing to explain himself to the realm, he said only: how could the imperial carriage fail within a few days?
translations.idiomatic: Returning to mount the throne again, wishing to explain himself to the realm, he said only: how could the imperial carriage fail within a few days?

sentences.zh: 海內聞之，靡不切齒。

translations.literal: When the realm heard of it, none did not gnash their teeth.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm heard of it, all gnashed their teeth in rage.

sentences.zh: 又私圖傳子，乃構邪言，嫁禍於八不沙皇后，謂朕非明宗之子，遂俾出居遐陬。

translations.literal: He further plotted privately to pass the throne to his son; he fabricated wicked words and shifted blame onto Empress Babusha, saying that I was not the son of Mingzong, and thus caused me to be sent to dwell in a distant corner.
translations.idiomatic: He further plotted privately to pass the throne to his son. He fabricated wicked words and shifted blame onto Empress Babusha, saying that I was not the son of Mingzong, and thus caused me to be sent to dwell in a distant corner.

sentences.zh: 祖宗大業，幾於不繼。

translations.literal: The great enterprise of the ancestors was nearly not continued.
translations.idiomatic: The great enterprise of the ancestors was nearly not continued.

sentences.zh: 內懷愧慊，則殺也裏牙以杜口。

translations.literal: Harbouring guilt within, he then killed Yiliya to stop mouths.
translations.idiomatic: Harbouring guilt within, he then killed Yiliya to silence witnesses.

sentences.zh: 上天不佑，隨降殞罰。

translations.literal: Heaven did not protect him, and punishment of death soon descended.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven did not protect him, and punishment of death soon descended.

sentences.zh: 叔嬸不答失裏，怙其勢焰，不立明考之冢嗣，而立孺稚之弟懿璘質班，奄復不年，諸王大臣以賢以長，扶朕踐位。

translations.literal: My aunt Budashiri, relying on her power and arrogance, did not establish the heir of Mingzong but established his infant younger brother Yishan Timur; he too soon died young; the princes and great ministers, considering worth and seniority, supported me in ascending the throne.
translations.idiomatic: My aunt Budashiri, relying on her power and arrogance, did not establish the heir of Mingzong but established his infant younger brother Yishan Timur. He too soon died young. The princes and great ministers, considering worth and seniority, supported me in ascending the throne.

sentences.zh: 國之大政，屬不自遂者，詎能枚舉。

translations.literal: As for the great affairs of state that were not at my own disposal, how could they be enumerated one by one?
translations.idiomatic: As for the great affairs of state that were not at my own disposal, how could they be enumerated one by one?

sentences.zh: 每念治必本於盡孝，事莫先於正名，賴天之靈。

translations.literal: Whenever I reflect that governance must be rooted in fulfilling filial piety and that no affair comes before rectifying names, I rely on the spirit of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever I reflect that governance must be rooted in fulfilling filial piety and that no affair comes before rectifying names, I rely on the spirit of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 權奸屏黜，盡孝正名，不容復緩，永惟鞠育罔極之恩，忍忘不共戴天之義。

translations.literal: The powerful traitors have been removed; to fulfill filial piety and rectify names brooks no further delay; ever mindful of the boundless grace of nurture, how could I bear to forget the duty of an irreconcilable enemy?
translations.idiomatic: The powerful traitors have been removed. To fulfill filial piety and rectify names brooks no further delay. Ever mindful of the boundless grace of nurture, how could I bear to forget the duty of an irreconcilable enemy?

sentences.zh: 既往之罪，不可勝誅，其命太常徹去脫脫木兒在廟之主。

translations.literal: Past crimes cannot be punished to exhaustion; I order the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to remove Togh Toq's spirit tablet from the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Past crimes cannot be punished to exhaustion. I order the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to remove Togh Toq's spirit tablet from the temple.

sentences.zh: 不答失裏本朕之嬸，乃陰構奸臣，弗體朕意，僭膺太皇太后之號，跡其閨門之禍，離間骨肉，罪惡尤重，揆之大義，削去鴻名，徙東安州安置。

translations.literal: Budashiri was originally my aunt by marriage, yet she secretly plotted with traitorous ministers, did not understand my intent, and presumptuously assumed the title of empress dowager; tracing the calamities of her inner chambers, she estranged flesh and blood, and her crimes were especially grave; measured by great righteousness, her exalted title is stripped away and she is transferred for settlement in Dong'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Budashiri was originally my aunt by marriage, yet she secretly plotted with traitorous ministers, did not understand my intent, and presumptuously assumed the title of empress dowager. Tracing the calamities of her inner chambers, she estranged flesh and blood, and her crimes were especially grave. Measured by great righteousness, her exalted title is stripped away and she is transferred for settlement in Dong'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 燕帖古思昔雖幼沖，理難同處，朕終不陷於覆轍，專務殘酷，惟放諸高麗，當時賊臣月魯不花、也裏牙已死，其以明裏董阿等明正典刑。

translations.literal: Although Yantughus was once young and immature, by principle he could hardly remain together with me; I will ultimately not fall into the error of the overturned cart and devote myself solely to cruelty; I only release him to Goryeo; at that time the traitorous ministers Yelu Buqa and Yiliya were already dead; let Mingli Dong'a and others be punished according to the proper statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Although Yantughus was once young and immature, by principle he could hardly remain together with me. I will ultimately not fall into the error of the overturned cart and devote myself solely to cruelty. I only release him to Goryeo. At that time the traitorous ministers Yelu Buqa and Yiliya were already dead. Let Mingli Dong'a and others be punished according to the proper statutes.

sentences.zh: 監察御史崔敬言燕帖古思不宜放逐，不報。

translations.literal: The investigating censor Cui Jing stated that Yantughus should not be banished; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: The investigating censor Cui Jing stated that Yantughus should not be banished. No response was given.

sentences.zh: 己亥，秦州成紀縣山崩地坼。

translations.literal: On jihai day, at Chengji County in Qin Prefecture, mountains collapsed and the earth split.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, at Chengji County in Qin Prefecture, mountains collapsed and the earth split open.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白復晝見。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Venus was again seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Venus was again seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太白晝見，夜犯歲星。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Venus was seen in daylight, and at night transgressed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Venus was seen in daylight, and at night transgressed the Year Star.

sentences.zh: 是月，濟南路歷城縣饑，賑鈔二千五百錠。

translations.literal: That month, Licheng County on the Jinan Route suffered famine; two thousand five hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Licheng County on the Jinan Route was starving. Two thousand five hundred ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，以也先帖木兒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renwu day, Yesun Temur was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renwu day, Yesun Temur was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥朔，明裏董阿伏誅。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the new moon of xinhai day, Mingli Dong'a was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of the xinhai day, Mingli Dong'a was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，加封漢張飛武義忠顯英烈靈惠助順王。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Han Zhang Fei was further ennobled as King of Martial Righteousness, Loyal Manifestation, Heroic Spirit, Favor, and Assisting Compliance.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Han Zhang Fei was further ennobled as King of Martial Righteousness, Loyal Manifestation, Heroic Spirit, Favor, and Assisting Compliance.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰犯虛梁。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the moon transgressed the Void Beam.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the moon transgressed the Void Beam.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔：「今後有罪者，毋籍其妻女以配人。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict stated: "Henceforth, for those who commit crimes, their wives and daughters shall not be registered and given in marriage to others."
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, an edict stated: "Henceforth, for those who commit crimes, their wives and daughters shall not be registered and given in marriage to others."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，太陰犯昴宿，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion, and Mars transgressed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion, and Mars transgressed the Year Star.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the moon transgressed the Chariot Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the moon transgressed the Chariot Pivot.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，奉玉冊、玉寶尊皇考為順天立道睿文智武大聖孝皇帝，親祼太室。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiashen day, jade registers and a jade seal were presented to honor the imperial father as Emperor of Filial Sagacity, Sagely and Martial, of Sagacious Culture and Wisdom, who accords with Heaven and establishes the Way; the emperor personally poured the libation in the Grand Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiashen day, jade registers and a jade seal were presented to honor the imperial father as Emperor of Filial Sagacity, Sagely and Martial, of Sagacious Culture and Wisdom, who accords with Heaven and establishes the Way. The emperor personally poured the libation in the Grand Chamber.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，奉符、長清、元城、清平四縣饑，詔遣制國用司官驗而賑之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the four counties of Fengfu, Changqing, Yuancheng, and Qingping suffered famine; an edict dispatched officials of the State Revenue Commission to inspect and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the four counties of Fengfu, Changqing, Yuancheng, and Qingping were starving. An edict dispatched officials of the State Revenue Commission to inspect and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，各愛馬人不許與常選。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, people of the various ai ma districts were not permitted to enter the regular selection.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, people of the various horse-pasture districts were not permitted to enter the regular civil-service selection.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，立曹南王阿剌罕、淮安王伯顏、河南王阿術祠堂。

translations.literal: On renchen day, spirit halls were established for Prince of Cao'nan Alaqa, Prince of Huai'an Bayan, and Prince of Henan Arigh.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, spirit halls were established for Prince of Cao'nan Alaqa, Prince of Huai'an Bayan, and Prince of Henan Arigh.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白入南斗。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Venus entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Venus entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，馬劄兒臺辭右丞相職，仍為太師。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Mažiltai resigned the post of right chief minister and remained Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Mažiltai resigned the post of right chief minister and remained grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 以脫脫為中書右丞相，宗正劄魯忽赤鐵木兒不花為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: Toqto was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat; Jarlugchi Temür Buqa, director of the Imperial Clan Court, was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat; Jarlugchi Temür Buqa, director of the Imperial Clan Court, was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南府宜陽等縣大水，漂沒民廬，溺死者眾，人給殯葬鈔一錠，仍賑義倉糧兩月。

translations.literal: That month, Yiyang and other counties in Henan Prefecture suffered great flood; people's dwellings were swept away and drowned, and many drowned; each person was given one ingot of paper money for burial, and charity-granary grain was issued for relief for two months.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yiyang and other counties in Henan Prefecture were struck by great flooding. People's dwellings were swept away and many drowned. Each person was given one ingot of paper money for burial, and charity-granary grain was issued for relief for two months.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，監察御史世圖爾言，宜禁答失蠻、回回、主吾人等叔伯為婚姻。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiayin day, the investigating censor Šitur stated that marriage between paternal uncles and nieces among the Qasar, Huihui, and Zhugu people should be prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiayin day, the investigating censor Šitur stated that marriage between paternal uncles and nieces among the Qasar, Huihui, and Zhugu people should be prohibited.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太陰犯虛梁。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the moon transgressed the Void Beam.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the moon transgressed the Void Beam.

sentences.zh: 以親祼大禮慶成，禦大明殿受群臣朝。

translations.literal: Because the great rite of personally pouring the libation was successfully completed, the emperor proceeded to the Hall of Great Brightness to receive the court's homage.
translations.idiomatic: Because the great rite of personally pouring the libation was successfully completed, the emperor proceeded to the Hall of Great Brightness to receive the court's homage.

sentences.zh: 戊午，熒惑犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Mars transgressed the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Mars transgressed the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲子，月食，辰星犯東咸。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, there was a lunar eclipse; Mercury transgressed the Eastern Bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, there was a lunar eclipse. Mercury transgressed the Eastern Bulwark.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以孔克堅襲封衍聖公。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Kong Kejian succeeded to the enfeoffment as Duke of the Sage's Lineage.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Kong Kejian succeeded to the enfeoffment as Duke of the Sage's Lineage.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，辰星犯天罡。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Mercury transgressed the Celestial Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Mercury transgressed the Celestial Chief.

sentences.zh: 是月，處州、婺州饑，以常平、義倉糧賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Chu and Wu prefectures suffered famine; grain from the Ever-Normal and charity granaries was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chu and Wu prefectures were starving. Grain from the ever-normal and charity granaries was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月，復科舉取士制。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, the civil-service examination system for selecting scholars was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the civil-service examination system for selecting scholars was restored.

sentences.zh: 國子監積分生員，三年一次，依科舉例入會試，中者取一十八名。

translations.literal: Graduate students of the Directorate of Education on the point system, once every three years, entered the metropolitan examination according to the examination precedent; eighteen who passed were selected.
translations.idiomatic: Graduate students of the Directorate of Education on the point system, once every three years, entered the metropolitan examination according to the examination precedent. Eighteen who passed were selected.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太陰犯虛梁。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the moon transgressed the Void Beam.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the moon transgressed the Void Beam.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯土公。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Earth Duke.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Earth Duke.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，熒惑犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Mars transgressed the Hooked Array.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Mars transgressed the Hooked Array.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷天歷以後增設太禧宗禋等院及奎章閣。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the Grand Council of Imperial Sacrifices and other offices and the Kui Zhang Pavilion added after the Tianli reign were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the Grand Council of Imperial Sacrifices and other offices and the Kui Zhang Pavilion added after the Tianli reign were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙未，熒惑犯東咸。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Mars transgressed the Eastern Bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Mars transgressed the Eastern Bulwark.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，東平路民饑，賑之。

translations.literal: That month, the people of the Dongping Route suffered famine; relief was issued.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of the Dongping Route were starving. Relief was issued.

sentences.zh: 寶慶路大雪，深四尺五寸。

translations.literal: On the Baqing Route, great snow fell to a depth of four chi and five cun.
translations.idiomatic: On the Baqing Route, great snow fell to a depth of four chi and five cun.

sentences.zh: 至正元年春正月己酉朔，改元，詔曰：

translations.literal: First year of Zhizheng, spring, first month, on the new moon of jiyou day, the era name was changed. The edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizheng, on the new moon of the jiyou day of the first month of spring, the era name was changed. The edict stated:

sentences.zh: 朕惟帝王之道，德莫大於克孝，治莫大於得賢。

translations.literal: I reflect that in the way of emperors and kings, no virtue is greater than fulfilling filial piety, and no governance is greater than obtaining the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that in the way of emperors and kings, no virtue is greater than fulfilling filial piety, and no governance is greater than obtaining the worthy.

sentences.zh: 朕早歷多難，入紹大統，仰思祖宗付托之重，戰兢惕勵，於茲八年。

translations.literal: I early endured many hardships and entered to continue the great succession; looking up, I ponder the heavy trust the ancestors conferred, and in fear and vigilance I have exerted myself for eight years now.
translations.idiomatic: I early endured many hardships and entered to continue the great succession. Looking up, I ponder the heavy trust the ancestors conferred, and in fear and vigilance I have exerted myself for eight years now.

sentences.zh: 慨念皇考，久勞於外，甫即大命，四海觖望，夙夜追慕，不忘於懷。

translations.literal: Sighing in remembrance of the imperial father, long toiling abroad, who had just received the great mandate when the realm was disappointed in its hopes; day and night I pursue my longing and do not forget it in my breast.
translations.idiomatic: Sighing in remembrance of the imperial father, long toiling abroad, who had just received the great mandate when the realm was disappointed in its hopes, day and night I pursue my longing and do not forget it in my breast.

sentences.zh: 乃以至元六年十月初四日，奉玉冊、玉寶，追上皇考曰順天立道睿文智武大聖孝皇帝，被服袞冕，祼於太室，式展孝誠。

translations.literal: Therefore on the fourth day of the tenth month of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, jade registers and a jade seal were presented to honor the imperial father as Emperor of Filial Sagacity, Sagely and Martial, of Sagacious Culture and Wisdom, who accords with Heaven and establishes the Way; robed in ceremonial dress, I poured the libation in the Grand Chamber to display filial sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore on the fourth day of the tenth month of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, jade registers and a jade seal were presented to honor the imperial father as Emperor of Filial Sagacity, Sagely and Martial, of Sagacious Culture and Wisdom, who accords with Heaven and establishes the Way. Robed in ceremonial dress, I poured the libation in the Grand Chamber to display filial sincerity.

sentences.zh: 十有一月六日，勉徇大禮慶成之請，禦大明殿受群臣朝。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the eleventh month, reluctantly acceding to the request that the great rite's celebration was complete, I proceeded to the Hall of Great Brightness to receive the court's homage.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the eleventh month, reluctantly acceding to the request that the great rite's celebration was complete, I proceeded to the Hall of Great Brightness to receive the court's homage.

sentences.zh: 爰自去春，疇咨於眾，以知樞密院事馬劄兒臺為太師、右丞相，以正百官，以親萬民。

translations.literal: From last spring, consulting the multitude, I appointed Mažiltai, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, as Grand Preceptor and right chief minister to rectify the hundred officials and be close to the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: From last spring, consulting the multitude, I appointed Mažiltai, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, as grand preceptor and right chief minister to rectify the hundred officials and be close to the myriad people.

sentences.zh: 尋即控辭，養疾私第，再三諭旨，勉令就位，自春徂秋，其請益固。

translations.literal: Soon he submitted a petition of resignation and nursed illness in his private residence; again and again I issued edicts urging him to take his post, but from spring to autumn his request grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he submitted a petition of resignation and nursed illness in his private residence. Again and again I issued edicts urging him to take his post, but from spring to autumn his request grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 朕憫其勞日久，察其至誠，不忍煩之以政，俾解機務，仍為太師。

translations.literal: I pitied his long labor and perceived his utmost sincerity; unwilling to trouble him further with government, I had him released from state affairs while he remained Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: I pitied his long labor and perceived his utmost sincerity. Unwilling to trouble him further with government, I had him released from state affairs while he remained grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 而知樞密院事脫脫，早歲輔朕，克著忠貞，乃命為中書右丞相；

translations.literal: Toqto, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, who in early years assisted me and proved loyal and steadfast, was then appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Toqto, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, who in early years assisted me and proved loyal and steadfast, was then appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 宗正劄魯忽赤帖木兒不花，嘗歷政府，嘉績著聞，為中書左丞相，並錄軍國重事。

translations.literal: Jarlugchi Temür Buqa, who had served in government and whose fine achievements were well known, was made left chief minister of the Secretariat and concurrently recorded matters of military and state importance.
translations.idiomatic: Jarlugchi Temür Buqa, who had served in government and whose fine achievements were well known, was made left chief minister of the Secretariat and concurrently recorded matters of military and state importance.

sentences.zh: 夫三公論道，以輔予德，二相總政，以弼予治，其以至元七年為至正元年，與天下更始。

translations.literal: The three dukes discuss the Way to assist my virtue; the two chancellors oversee government to aid my rule; let the seventh year of Zhiyuan become the first year of Zhizheng, and begin anew with the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The three dukes discuss the Way to assist my virtue; the two chancellors oversee government to aid my rule. Let the seventh year of Zhiyuan become the first year of Zhizheng, and begin anew with the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，熒惑犯天江。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔天壽節禁屠宰六日。

translations.literal: On guihai day, an edict prohibited slaughter for six days on the Heavenly Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, an edict prohibited slaughter for six days on the Heavenly Longevity Festival.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白晝見，凡四日。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Venus was seen in daylight, for four days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Venus was seen in daylight, for four days in all.

sentences.zh: 是月，命脫脫領經筵事。

translations.literal: That month, Toqto was ordered to oversee the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: That month Toqto was ordered to oversee the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 命永明寺寫金字經一藏。

translations.literal: Yongming Temple was ordered to copy one canon of gold-letter sutras.
translations.idiomatic: Yongming Temple was ordered to copy one canon of gold-letter sutras.

sentences.zh: 免天下稅糧五分。

translations.literal: Five-tenths of the realm's tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Five-tenths of the realm's tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 湖南諸路饑，賑糶米十八萬九千七十六石。

translations.literal: The various routes of Hunan suffered famine; one hundred eighty-nine thousand seventy-six shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The various routes of Hunan were starving. One hundred eighty-nine thousand seventy-six shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuyin day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuyin day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白復晝見。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Venus was again seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Venus was again seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，立廣福庫，罷藏珍等庫。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the Broad Blessings Storehouse was established and the Treasured Rarities Storehouse and others were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Broad Blessings Storehouse was established and the Treasured Rarities Storehouse and others were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，濟南濱州沾化等縣饑，以鈔五萬三千錠賑之。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Zhanhua and other counties in Jinan and Bin Prefectures suffered famine; fifty-three thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Zhanhua and other counties in Jinan and Bin prefectures were starving. Fifty-three thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加封皇姊不答昔你明惠貞懿大長公主。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the emperor's elder sister Budashini was further enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Bright Favor, Chaste Integrity, and Pure Grace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the emperor's elder sister Budashini was further enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Bright Favor, Chaste Integrity, and Pure Grace.

sentences.zh: 是月，大都寶坻縣饑，賑米兩月。

translations.literal: That month, Baodi County in the capital region suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for two months.
translations.idiomatic: That month Baodi County in the capital region was starving. Grain relief was provided for two months.

sentences.zh: 河間莫州、滄州等處饑，賑鈔三萬五千錠。

translations.literal: Mozhou, Cangzhou, and other places in Hejian suffered famine; thirty-five thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Mozhou, Cangzhou, and other districts in Hejian were starving. Thirty-five thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 晉州饒陽、阜平、安喜、靈壽四縣饑，賑鈔二萬錠。

translations.literal: The four counties of Raoyang, Fuping, Anxi, and Lingshou in Jin Prefecture suffered famine; twenty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The four counties of Raoyang, Fuping, Anxi, and Lingshou in Jin Prefecture were starving. Twenty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 印造至元鈔九十九萬錠、中統鈔一萬錠。

translations.literal: Nine hundred ninety thousand ingots of Zhiyuan paper money and ten thousand ingots of Zhongtong paper money were printed.
translations.idiomatic: Nine hundred ninety thousand ingots of Zhiyuan paper money and ten thousand ingots of Zhongtong paper money were printed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，罷兩淮屯田手號打捕軍役，令屬本所領之。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengxu day, the military service of the Lianghuai garrison-farm hand-tally hunting and fishing troops was abolished, and they were ordered to belong to their original commands.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengxu day, the military service of the Lianghuai garrison-farm hand-tally hunting and fishing troops was abolished, and they were ordered to belong to their original commands.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命屯儲禦軍於河南芍陂、洪澤、德安三處屯種。

translations.literal: On guichou day, imperial troops for garrison and storage were ordered to farm at Shaopi, Hongze, and De'an in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, imperial troops for garrison and storage were ordered to farm at Shaopi, Hongze, and De'an in Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，給還帖木兒不花宣讓王印，鎮淮西。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the seal of Prince of Xuanrang was returned to Temür Buqa to guard the Huai west.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the seal of Prince of Xuanrang was returned to Temür Buqa to guard the Huai west.

sentences.zh: 己未，汴梁地震。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Bianliang suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Bianliang was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 大都路涿州范陽、房山饑，賑鈔四千錠。

translations.literal: Fanyang and Fangshan in Zhuo Prefecture on the capital route suffered famine; four thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Fanyang and Fangshan in Zhuo Prefecture on the capital route were starving. Four thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以行省平章政事燕帖木兒就佩虎符，提調屯田。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Yantughus, chief minister of the branch secretariat, was immediately granted the tiger tally to supervise garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Yantughus, chief minister of the branch secretariat, was immediately granted the tiger tally to supervise garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 是月，般陽路長山等縣饑，賑鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: That month, Changshan and other counties on the Panyang Route suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Changshan and other counties on the Panyang Route were starving. Ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 彰德路安陽等縣饑，賑鈔萬五千錠。

translations.literal: Anyang and other counties on the Zhangde Route suffered famine; fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Anyang and other counties on the Zhangde Route were starving. Fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑朔，道州土賊蔣丙等反，破江華縣，掠明遠縣。
