translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the new moon of dingchou day, the native bandit Jiang Bing and others of Dao Prefecture rebelled, seized Jianghua County, and plundered Mingyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of the dingchou day, the native bandit Jiang Bing and others of Dao Prefecture rebelled, seized Jianghua County, and plundered Mingyuan County.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，彰德有赤風自西北起，晝晦如夜。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, at Zhangde a red wind arose from the northwest, and daylight was dark as night.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, at Zhangde a red wind arose from the northwest, and daylight was dark as night.

sentences.zh: 甲申，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，臨賀縣民被徭寇鈔掠，發義倉糧賑之。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the people of Linhe County were plundered by Yao bandits; charity-granary grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the people of Linhe County were plundered by Yao bandits. Charity-granary grain was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，帝幸護聖寺。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the emperor visited Husheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the emperor visited Husheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 命中書右丞鐵木兒塔識為平章政事，阿魯為右丞，許有壬為左丞。

translations.literal: Temür Taši, right vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed chief minister; Aru was appointed right vice director; Xu Youren was appointed left vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Temür Taši, right vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed chief minister; Aru was appointed right vice director; Xu Youren was appointed left vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立富昌庫，隸資正院。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the Fuchang Storehouse was established, subordinate to the Court of Correct Resources.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the Fuchang Storehouse was established, subordinate to the Court of Correct Resources.

sentences.zh: 復立衛候司。

translations.literal: The Office of Palace Guards was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Palace Guards was re-established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以兩浙水災，免歲辦余鹽三萬引。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, because of flooding in the two Zhe regions, the annual quota of surplus salt of thirty thousand yin was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, because of flooding in the two Zhe regions, the annual quota of surplus salt of thirty thousand yin was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，立吏部司績官。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the Ministry of Personnel's merit-review officer was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the Ministry of Personnel's merit-review officer was established.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復封太師馬劄兒臺為忠王。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Grand Preceptor Mažiltai was again enfeoffed as Prince of Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Grand Preceptor Mažiltai was again enfeoffed as Prince of Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 罷漷州河西務。

translations.literal: The Hexiwu office of Huazhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexiwu office of Huazhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 彰德饑，賑鈔萬五千錠。

translations.literal: Zhangde suffered famine; fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde was starving. Fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，以崇文監屬翰林國史院。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wushen day, the Directorate of Literary Culture was placed under the Hanlin Academy and National History Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wushen day, the Directorate of Literary Culture was placed under the Hanlin Academy and National History Office.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷河西務行用庫。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the Hexiwu circulating storehouse was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the Hexiwu circulating storehouse was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，月食。

translations.literal: On renxu day, there was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, there was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑阿剌忽等處被災之民三千九百一十三戶，給鈔二萬一千七百五錠。

translations.literal: That month, three thousand nine hundred thirteen households of disaster-stricken people at Alaqu and other places were relieved; twenty-one thousand seven hundred five ingots of paper money were issued.
translations.idiomatic: That month three thousand nine hundred thirteen households of disaster-stricken people at Alaqu and other places were relieved. Twenty-one thousand seven hundred five ingots of paper money were issued.

sentences.zh: 閏五月丁丑朔，改封徽州土神汪華為昭忠廣仁武烈靈顯王。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, on the new moon of dingchou day, the native god Wang Hua of Huizhou was re-enfeoffed as King of Bright Loyalty, Broad Benevolence, Martial Valor, and Spirit Manifestation.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on the new moon of the dingchou day, the native god Wang Hua of Huizhou was re-enfeoffed as King of Bright Loyalty, Broad Benevolence, Martial Valor, and Spirit Manifestation.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賞賜扈從明宗諸王官屬八百七人金、銀、鈔、幣各有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, eight hundred seven officials and attendants of the princes who had followed Mingzong were rewarded with gold, silver, paper money, and silks in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, eight hundred seven officials and attendants of the princes who had followed Mingzong were rewarded with gold, silver, paper money, and silks in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔刻宣文、至正二寶。

translations.literal: On renyin day, an edict ordered the carving of the two seals Xuanwen and Zhizheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict ordered the carving of the two seals Xuanwen and Zhizheng.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，禁高麗及諸處民以親子為宦者，因避賦役。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuwu day, Koreans and people of various places were forbidden to make their own sons eunuchs in order to avoid tax and corvée service.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuwu day, Koreans and people of various places were forbidden to make their own sons eunuchs in order to avoid tax and corvée service.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改舊奎章閣為宣文閣。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the former Kui Zhang Pavilion was renamed the Xuanwen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the former Kui Zhang Pavilion was renamed the Xuanwen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，揚州路崇明、通、泰等州，海潮湧溢，溺死一千六百餘人，賑鈔萬一千八百二十錠。

translations.literal: That month, at Chongming, Tong, Tai, and other prefectures on the Yangzhou Route, the sea tide overflowed and more than sixteen hundred people drowned; eleven thousand eight hundred twenty ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month at Chongming, Tong, Tai, and other prefectures on the Yangzhou Route, the sea tide overflowed and more than sixteen hundred people drowned. Eleven thousand eight hundred twenty ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Earth Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Earth Star.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太陰犯雲雨。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the moon transgressed Cloud and Rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the moon transgressed Cloud and Rain.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wushen day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wushen day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengchen day, the moon transgressed the Establishment star.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengchen day, the moon transgressed the Establishment star.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜文臣燕於拱辰堂。

translations.literal: On renwu day, a banquet was bestowed upon civil officials at the Gongchen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, a banquet was bestowed upon civil officials at the Gongchen Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，冀寧路嘉禾生，異畝同穎。

translations.literal: On jichou day, on the Jining Route fine grain grew; in different fields the ears were alike.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, on the Jining Route fine grain grew; in different fields the ears were alike.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太陰犯鉞星，又犯井宿。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the moon transgressed the Battle-axe star and again transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the moon transgressed the Battle-axe star and again transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，許有壬進講明仁殿，帝悅，賜酒宣文閣中，仍賜貂裘、金織文幣。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Xu Youren lectured in the Hall of Bright Benevolence; the emperor was pleased and bestowed wine in the Xuanwen Pavilion, and further bestowed a sable fur coat and gold-woven patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Xu Youren lectured in the Hall of Bright Benevolence. The emperor was pleased and bestowed wine in the Xuanwen Pavilion, and further bestowed a sable fur coat and gold-woven patterned silks.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封阿沙不花順寧王，昔寶赤寒食順國公。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Ashaqbuqa was enfeoffed as Prince of Shunning; Siboqchi was enfeoffed as Duke of Shun on the Cold Food Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Ashaqbuqa was enfeoffed as Prince of Shunning; Siboqchi was enfeoffed as Duke of Shun on the Cold Food Festival.

translations.literal: On jiayin day, secretariat officials memorialized: "Sea transport cannot supply enough; the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat should be ordered to allocate from the Central Governance Court's revenue office the grain from temple and monastery lands bestowed to various persons, totaling two million six hundred thousand shi for transport."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, secretariat officials memorialized: "Sea transport cannot supply enough. sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was accepted.

translations.literal: On yimao day, Jupiter transgressed the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Jupiter transgressed the Root mansion.

translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the moon transgressed the moon star.

translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, there was a total lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，道州路賊何仁甫等反。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingzi day, the bandits He Renfu and others of the Dao Prefecture Route rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingzi day, the bandits He Renfu and others of the Dao Prefecture Route rebelled.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，彰德屬縣各添設縣尉一員。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, each subordinate county of Zhangde was given an additional county commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, each subordinate county of Zhangde was given an additional county commandant.

translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Ministries of Personnel, Rites, War, and Punishments were each divided into two storehouses, and the Ministries of Revenue and Works into two storehouses. Each was given one controller.

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 徭賊寇邊，詔湖廣行省平章政事鞏卜班總兵討平之，定賞有差。

translations.literal: Yao bandits raided the border; an edict ordered Qongbuqan, chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, to command troops to suppress and pacify them; rewards were fixed in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Yao bandits raided the border. An edict ordered Qongbuqan, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, to command troops to suppress and pacify them. Rewards were fixed in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，詔：「民年八十以上，蒙古人賜繒帛二表裏，其餘州縣，旌以高年耆德之名，免其家雜役。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao day, an edict stated: "For people eighty years of age and above, Mongols are granted two sets of silk robes; in other prefectures and counties they are honored with the title of venerable age and virtue, and miscellaneous corvée service for their households is remitted."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yimao day, an edict stated: "For people eighty years of age and above, Mongols are granted two sets of silk robes. In other prefectures and counties they are honored with the title of venerable age and virtue, and miscellaneous corvée service for their households is remitted."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 己未，立四川安嶽縣。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Anyue County in Sichuan was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Anyue County in Sichuan was established.

sentences.zh: 增設嘉興等處鹽倉。

translations.literal: Salt storehouses at Jiaxing and other places were additionally established.
translations.idiomatic: Salt storehouses at Jiaxing and other places were additionally established.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，雲南車裏寒賽、刀等反，詔雲南行省平章政事脫脫木兒討平之。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Hansai, Dao, and others of Cheli in Yunnan rebelled; an edict ordered Toqto Temür, chief minister of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat, to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Hansai, Dao, and others of Cheli in Yunnan rebelled. An edict ordered Toqto Temür, chief minister of the Yunnan branch secretariat, to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以在庫至元、中統鈔二百八十二萬二千四百八十八錠可支二年，住造明年鈔本。

translations.literal: On guihai day, because the Zhiyuan and Zhongtong paper money in the treasury, two million eight hundred twenty-two thousand four hundred eighty-eight ingots, could support two years, printing of next year's notes was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, because the Zhiyuan and Zhongtong paper money in the treasury, two million eight hundred twenty-two thousand four hundred eighty-eight ingots, could support two years, printing of next year's notes was halted.

sentences.zh: 詔革王伯顏察兒等所獻檀、景等處產金地土。

translations.literal: An edict abolished the gold-producing lands at Tan, Jing, and other places presented by Wang Bayan Qar and others.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished the gold-producing lands at Tan, Jing, and other places presented by Wang Bayan Qar and others.

sentences.zh: 山東、燕南強盜縱橫，至三百餘處，選官捕之。

translations.literal: Robbers ran rampant in Shandong and Yan south, reaching more than three hundred places; officials were selected to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Robbers ran rampant in Shandong and Yan south, reaching more than three hundred places. Officials were selected to capture them.

sentences.zh: 復立拱儀局。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Court Ceremony was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Court Ceremony was re-established.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以翰林學士承旨張起巖知經筵事。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Zhang Qiyan, academician ex officio of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Zhang Qiyan, academician ex officio of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 是月，復立司禋監。

translations.literal: That month, the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was re-established.

sentences.zh: 加封真定路滹沱河神為昭佑靈源侯。

translations.literal: The god of the Hutuo River on the Zhending Route was further enfeoffed as Marquis of Bright Protection and Spirit Source.
translations.idiomatic: The god of the Hutuo River on the Zhending Route was further enfeoffed as Marquis of Bright Protection and Spirit Source.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁丑，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on dingchou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the dingchou day of the first month of spring, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，開京師金口河，深五十尺，廣一百五十尺，役夫一十萬。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the Jinkou River in the capital was opened; it was fifty chi deep and one hundred fifty chi wide, with one hundred thousand laborers employed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the Jinkou River in the capital was opened. It was fifty chi deep and one hundred fifty chi wide, with one hundred thousand laborers employed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣翰林學士三保等代祀五嶽四瀆。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Hanlin academician Sanbao and others were dispatched to perform sacrifices at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers on the emperor's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Hanlin academician Sanbao and others were dispatched to perform sacrifices at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers on the emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 甲午，熒惑犯月星。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Mars transgressed the moon star.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Mars transgressed the moon star.

sentences.zh: 是月，大同饑，人相食，運京師糧賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Datong suffered famine and people ate one another; grain from the capital was transported for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Datong was starving and people ate one another. Grain from the capital was transported for relief.

sentences.zh: 順寧保安饑，賑鈔一萬錠。

translations.literal: Shunning and Bao'an suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shunning and Bao'an were starving. Ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 廣平磁、威州饑，賑鈔五萬錠。

translations.literal: Ci and Wei prefectures in Guangping suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ci and Wei prefectures in Guangping were starving. Fifty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 降咸平府為縣；

translations.literal: Xianping Prefecture was reduced to a county;
translations.idiomatic: Xianping Prefecture was reduced to a county;

sentences.zh: 升懿州為路，以大寧路所轄興中、義州屬懿州。

translations.literal: Yi Prefecture was promoted to a route, and Xingzhong and Yi prefectures under the Daning Route were placed under Yi Route.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefecture was promoted to a route, and Xingzhong and Yi prefectures under the Daning Route were placed under Yi Route.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，頒《農桑輯要》。

translations.literal: Second month, on renyin day, the 《Essentials of Agriculture and Sericulture》 was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day, the 《Essentials of Agriculture and Sericulture》 was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，李沙的偽造御寶聖旨，稱樞密院都事，伏誅。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Li Shadi forged an imperial edict with the imperial seal and styled himself director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Li Shadi forged an imperial edict with the imperial seal and styled himself director of the Bureau of Military Affairs. He was executed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，織造明宗御容。

translations.literal: On jisi day, the imperial portrait of Mingzong was woven.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the imperial portrait of Mingzong was woven.

sentences.zh: 是月，彰德路安陽、臨漳等縣饑，賑鈔二萬錠。

translations.literal: That month, Anyang, Linzhang, and other counties on the Zhangde Route suffered famine; twenty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Anyang, Linzhang, and other counties on the Zhangde Route were starving. Twenty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 大同路渾源州饑，以鈔六萬二千錠、糧二萬石兼賑之。

translations.literal: Hunyuan Prefecture on the Datong Route suffered famine; sixty-two thousand ingots of paper money and twenty thousand shi of grain were jointly issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Hunyuan Prefecture on the Datong Route was starving. Sixty-two thousand ingots of paper money and twenty thousand shi of grain were jointly issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 大名路饑，以鈔萬二千錠賑之。

translations.literal: The Daming Route suffered famine; twelve thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: The Daming Route was starving. Twelve thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 河間路饑，以鈔五萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: The Hejian Route suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: The Hejian Route was starving. Fifty thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，親試進士七十八人，賜拜住、陳祖仁及第，其餘出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuyin day, seventy-eight jinshi candidates were personally examined; Baizhu and Chen Zuren were granted top honors, and the rest received degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuyin day, seventy-eight jinshi candidates were personally examined. Baizhu and Chen Zuren were granted top honors, and the rest received degrees in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，冀寧路饑，賑糶米三萬石。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the Jining Route suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Jining Route was starving. Thirty thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，順德路平鄉縣饑，賑鈔萬五千錠。

translations.literal: That month, Pingxiang County on the Shunde Route suffered famine; fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Pingxiang County on the Shunde Route was starving. Fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 衛輝路饑，賑鈔萬五千錠。

translations.literal: The Weihui Route suffered famine; fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Weihui Route was starving. Fifteen thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 杭州路火災，給鈔萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: The Hangzhou Route suffered fire; ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Hangzhou Route suffered fire. Ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑朔，冀寧路平晉縣地震，聲鳴如雷，裂地尺餘，民居皆傾。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the new moon of xinchou day, Pingjin County on the Jining Route suffered an earthquake; the sound was like thunder, the earth split more than a chi, and dwellings all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of the xinchou day, Pingjin County on the Jining Route was struck by an earthquake. The sound was like thunder, the earth split more than a chi, and dwellings all collapsed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yisi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷雲南蒙慶宣慰司。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the Mengqing Pacification Commission of Yunnan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the Mengqing Pacification Commission of Yunnan was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太陰犯羅堰。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the moon transgressed the Luo Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the moon transgressed the Luo Embankment.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage made a seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，太白經天。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiashen day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiashen day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以江浙行省平章政事只而瓦臺為河南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Jierwatai, chief minister of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Jierwatai, chief minister of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 東平雨雹如馬首。

translations.literal: At Dongping, hail fell as large as horses' heads.
translations.idiomatic: At Dongping, hail fell as large as horses' heads.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，命江浙撥賜僧道田還官征糧，以備軍儲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wushen day, Jiang-Zhe was ordered to allocate bestowed temple and monastery lands back to the state for grain collection to supply military stores.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wushen day, Jiang-Zhe was ordered to allocate bestowed temple and monastery lands back to the state for grain collection to supply military stores.

sentences.zh: 壬子，濟南山崩，水湧。

translations.literal: On renzi day, mountains collapsed at Jinan and water surged forth.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, mountains collapsed at Jinan and water surged forth.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，支邦牙宣慰司。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the Zhibangya Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Zhibangya Pacification Commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是月，汾水大溢。

translations.literal: That month, the Fen River overflowed greatly.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Fen River overflowed greatly.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，惠州路羅浮山崩。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day, Mount Luofu on the Huizhou Route collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Mount Luofu on the Huizhou Route collapsed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰掩太白。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon occulted Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon occulted Venus.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己亥，慶遠路莫八聚眾反，攻陷南丹、左右兩江等處，命脫脫赤顏討平之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Mo Ba gathered a multitude and rebelled on the Qingyuan Route, seized Nandan and the left and right two rivers and other places; Toqto Qiyan was ordered to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Mo Ba gathered a multitude and rebelled on the Qingyuan Route, seizing Nandan and the left and right two rivers and other places. Toqto Qiyan was ordered to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 立司獄司於上都，比大都兵馬司。

translations.literal: A prison office was established at Shangdu, comparable to the capital's military and police office.
translations.idiomatic: A prison office was established at Shangdu, comparable to the capital's military and police office.

sentences.zh: 是月，拂郎國貢異馬，長一丈一尺三寸，高六尺四寸，身純黑，後二蹄皆白。

translations.literal: That month, the state of Folang presented a strange horse, eleven chi and three cun long, six chi and four cun high, entirely black in body, with both hind hooves white.
translations.idiomatic: That month the state of Folang presented a strange horse, eleven chi and three cun long, six chi and four cun high, entirely black in body, with both hind hooves white.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the new moon of gengzi day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of the gengzi day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷上都事產提舉司。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the Shangdu estate intendant office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the Shangdu estate intendant office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 是月，冀寧路饑，賑糶米萬五千石。

translations.literal: That month, the Jining Route suffered famine; fifteen thousand shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jining Route was starving. Fifteen thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，詔遣湖廣行省平章政事鞏卜班領河南、江浙、湖廣諸軍討道州賊，平之，復平奚峒堡寨二百餘處。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jisi day, an edict dispatched Qongbuqan, chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, to lead the armies of Henan, Jiang-Zhe, and Huguang to campaign against the bandits of Dao Prefecture; they were pacified, and more than two hundred Xi cave fortresses were also pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, an edict dispatched Qongbuqan, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, to lead the armies of Henan, Jiang-Zhe, and Huguang to campaign against the bandits of Dao Prefecture. They were pacified, and more than two hundred Xi cave fortresses were also pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯羅堰。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the moon transgressed the Luo Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the moon transgressed the Luo Embankment.

sentences.zh: 京城強賊四起。

translations.literal: Powerful bandits rose up on all sides in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful bandits rose up on all sides in the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，歸德府睢陽縣因黃河為患，民饑，賑糶米萬三千五百石。

translations.literal: That month, because of calamity from the Yellow River at Suiyang County in Guide Prefecture, the people suffered famine; thirteen thousand five hundred shi of grain were issued and sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because of calamity from the Yellow River at Suiyang County in Guide Prefecture, the people were starving. Thirteen thousand five hundred shi of grain were issued and sold at relief prices.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the new moon of jihai day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon of the jihai day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the moon transgressed the Establishment star.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the moon transgressed the Establishment star.

sentences.zh: 陜西行省平章政事朵朵辭職侍親，不允。

translations.literal: Duodu, chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, resigned his post to attend his parents; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Duodu, chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, resigned his post to attend his parents. The request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太陰犯天關。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the moon transgressed the Heavenly Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the moon transgressed the Heavenly Gate.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔遣官致祭孔子於曲阜。

translations.literal: On renxu day, an edict dispatched officials to offer sacrifice to Confucius at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, an edict dispatched officials to offer sacrifice to Confucius at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 罷織染提舉司。

translations.literal: The weaving and dyeing intendant office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The weaving and dyeing intendant office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，杭州、嘉興、紹興、溫州、臺州等路各立檢校批驗鹽引所，權免兩浙額鹽十萬引，福建余鹽三萬引。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, at Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Shaoxing, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other routes, inspection and verification offices for salt certificates were each established; the quota salt of the two Zhe regions was temporarily remitted by one hundred thousand yin, and Fujian surplus salt by thirty thousand yin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, at Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Shaoxing, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other routes, inspection and verification offices for salt certificates were each established. The quota salt of the two Zhe regions was temporarily remitted by one hundred thousand yin, and Fujian surplus salt by thirty thousand yin.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，詔免雲南明年差稅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen day, an edict remitted Yunnan's corvée and tax levies for the following year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiashen day, an edict remitted Yunnan's corvée and tax levies for the following year.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，歲星、熒惑、太白聚於尾宿。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Tail mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Tail mansion.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，申服色之禁。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renyin day, the prohibition on clothing colors was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin day, the prohibition on clothing colors was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命中書右丞太平、樞密副使姚庸、御史中丞張起巖知經筵事。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Taiping, right vice director of the Secretariat; Yao Yong, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Zhang Qiyan, vice censor-in-chief, were appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Taiping, right vice director of the Secretariat; Yao Yong, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Zhang Qiyan, vice censor-in-chief, were appointed to oversee the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 己酉，京師地震。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封晃火帖木兒之子徹裏帖木兒為撫寧王。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Qorqas Temür's son Čerig Temür was enfeoffed as Prince of Funing.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Qorqas Temür's son Čerig Temür was enfeoffed as Prince of Funing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賜雲南行省參知政事不老三珠虎符，以兵討死可伐。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Bulao, associate administrator of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat, was granted a three-pearl tiger tally to campaign with troops against Sikaifa.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Bulao, associate administrator of the Yunnan branch secretariat, was granted a three-pearl tiger tally to campaign with troops against Sikaifa.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，阿魯、禿滿等以謀害宰臣，圖為叛逆，伏誅。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Aru, Tuman, and others, for plotting to murder chief ministers and intending rebellion, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Aru, Tuman, and others, for plotting to murder chief ministers and intending rebellion, were executed.
